fullDescription: FlowState is a minimalist, high-end productivity OS design system characterized by an editorial aesthetic, sophisticated cream-based color palette, and premium glassmorphism. It leverages high-contrast typography pairing Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, AI tools, fintech landing pages, and professional productivity apps. The design features floating navigation docks, soft organic SVG blobs, layered shadow systems, and fluid spring-based animations to create a 'state of flow' user experience.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, modern productivity OS design system using a neutral cream and black palette. It focuses on massive display typography, spacious layouts, and interactive floating elements that utilize glassmorphism and multi-layered shadows.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a minimalist 'Productivity OS' aesthetic. Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings (Weights 800, 700) with tight tracking and leading (0.85-0.95); use 'Satoshi' (Weights 400, 500) for body and UI elements. Colors: Backgrounds in Cream (#fafaf8, #f5f5f0), Text in Jet Black (#0a0a0a) or Neutral Gray (#737373). Glassmorphism: Define 'glass' as background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65) with 20px backdrop-filter blur; 'glass-strong' as rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) with 24px blur. Shadows: Use a multi-layered 'floating' shadow (0 8px 40px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)). Animations: Implement a floating vertical translation (±20px) with a 2-degree rotation over 8-12 seconds. Use spring transitions (stiffness: 200, damping: 25) for all UI entrances.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Floating Navigation Dock
Create a fixed top-center navigation pill. Design: Glassmorphism background, 1px white/30 border, pill-shaped (rounded-full). Elements: Brand logo on the left, a series of 44x44px circular icon buttons with hover-lift effects, and a high-contrast 'Get Started' CTA button on the right. Spacing: 24px from top edge, internal padding 8px horizontally.

### Hero Section
Layout: Centered text stack over a large organic SVG blob background. Title: Massive display text ('FlowState') at 128px+, font-weight 800, leading-none. Subtitle: 24px neutral text max-width 2xl. CTA: Primary black button (rounded-full, 16px vertical padding) paired with a secondary bordered button. Background: Include a soft radial gradient overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.03) at center).

### Stats Grid
Positioned below the hero. Layout: 3-column grid of Stat Cards. Card Design: 32px border-radius, white/80 glass background, internal 32px padding. Elements: Large 48px+ heading for values, 14px uppercase label. Hover: Apply 'shadow-floating-hover' with a subtle scale up.

### Wave Transitions
Use 80px high SVG paths to transition between background colors. Path: 'M0,80 C240,0 480,80 720,40 C960,0 1200,80 1440,40 L1440,80 L0,80 Z'. Ensure paths are responsive and fill the width of the container.

### Feature Bento Grid
Grid: 3 columns (responsive to 1). Card Design: 40px border-radius, pure white background, 1px neutral-100 border. Content: 64x64px rounded-icon-container (20px radius) with light gray fill, 24px bold title, 16px leading-relaxed body text. Micro-interaction: Icon container should scale 1.1x on card hover.

### Central Timeline
Layout: Vertical center line (2px wide) with 16px circular dots at each step. Content: Alternate content cards to the left and right of the line. Mobile: Stack everything to the right of the line. Card Style: 32px border-radius, white, elevated shadow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Floating Dock — A high-end navigation system that mimics OS docks.
The dock must be 'fixed' at top: 24px, left: 50%, transform: translateX(-50%). It requires a backdrop-filter blur of 20px and a background of white/65. Internal icon buttons (44x44px) should have a 'whileHover' scale of 1.15 and 'whileTap' scale of 0.95. Use Lucide icons sized 20px.

### Organic SVG Blobs — Background decorative elements that pulse and float.
Inject large SVG paths (viewBox 0 0 200 200) with complex 'd' attributes into section backgrounds. Fill with #f0efed or #eae9e7. Apply CSS animation 'blob-pulse' which scales from 1 to 1.05 and varies opacity from 0.6 to 0.8 over a 10s ease-in-out loop.

style.description: The style is 'Minimalist Editorial' with a focus on tactile glass elements and organic motion. Typography uses a mix of ultra-bold sans-serif headings (Cabinet Grotesk) and clean geometric body text (Satoshi). The color scheme is centered on warm creams (#fafaf8, #f5f5f0), stark blacks (#0a0a0a), and soft border accents. Motion is defined by spring physics and floating animations that suggest weightlessness.
